name: Maverick Engineering Company
capabilities: Dual and single side fine grinding machines
india_angle: The company is located near Chennai, India, and operates under the 'Make in India' policy.
summary: Maverick Engineering Company manufactures precise lapping and polishing machines, including nano-wafer lap and polish equipment, which are crucial for semiconductor wafer processing. They focus on both single and dual side grinding and polishing machines, exporting to the Middle East and supporting the semiconductor industry with high-precision equipment.
